skill_name: Summarize the book in four sentences.
workflow: Harry Potter is an orphan living with cruel relatives and discovers that he is a wizard. He attends Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and quickly makes friends with Ron and Hermione. There, he embarks on a mission to find a powerful, mystical stone that can grant wishes. Despite treacherous obstacles and dangerous battles, Harry is determined to protect the stone from evil forces.
